title: Guava and Mousse Brazilian-Style Empanadas
description: A sweet twist on traditional empanadas, these Brazilian-inspired treats feature a flaky crust, a creamy guava filling, and a dollop of mousse on top.
instructions: Roll out the pastry dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a tablespoon of guava jam in the center of each dough circle.
Top with a tablespoon of guava puree and a dollop of mousse.
Fold the dough in half over the filling and press the edges to seal.
Brush the tops with confectioners' sugar and vanilla extract.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
